Managing Partner

Legal practice with a public-education instinct.

Susan Mute is an Advocate of the High Court of Kenya and Managing Partner at Susan Mute & Company Advocates.

Her public work connects mainstream legal service with sustained commentary on data protection, privacy, cybersecurity and AI regulation.

Susan has published in Citizen Digital and Business Daily. The Media Council of Kenya also listed her among the Social Media and Internet subgroup members of its technical working group on AI, Data and Social Media guidelines.
